name: Saidpur
sourceCustodian: Department of Land Records and Surveys (DLRS), Government of Bangladesh; the public national land-map portal lists Saidpur as covered.

queryOutcomes.english: Official DLRS, Settlement map search, national land-map, and DLRS map-purchase pages found. Saidpur coverage is explicitly named by the national land-map page.
queryOutcomes.bengali: Official Bengali-language DLRS and land-map pages found; Saidpur (সৈয়দপুর) is explicitly listed in the coverage notice. No parcel geometry was obtained.
queryOutcomes.viewerConfiguration: https://settlement.gov.bd/Map/MapSearch loads /js/MapSearch.js. The script exposes POST /Map/GetDivisionList, /Khatian/getdistrictlistdivisionwise, /Khatian/GetSurveyListDistrictWise, /Khatian/GetThanaListBySurveyMap, /Khatian/GetMouzaListBySurveyMap, /Khatian/GetSheetJsonBySurvey and GET /Khatian/GetSheetListBySurveyMap. It also exposes /tiles/parcels/{rsnum}/{comcod}/{unitcod}/{z}/{x}/{y}.pbf and /meta. The legacy response path is GeoJSON; the vector tiles use a source _fid but no safe stable parcel identity was proven.
requests: POST https://settlement.gov.bd/Map/GetDivisionList with an empty body: succeeded and returned division records; Rangpur was unitcod 080000000.
POST https://settlement.gov.bd/Khatian/getdistrictlistdivisionwise with divid=080000000: succeeded and returned Nilphamari as unitcod 080500000, comcod 4186.

POST https://settlement.gov.bd/Khatian/GetSurveyListDistrictWise with districtid=080500000 and comcod=4186: returned an empty JSON array; no survey route could be selected for the follow-on Saidpur query.

POST https://settlement.gov.bd/Khatian/GetThanaListBySurveyMap with comcod=4186, rsno1=4, districtid=080500000: returned an empty JSON array; rsno1=4 was only a bounded probe and not treated as a valid survey selection.
GET https://map.land.gov.bd/ followed by POST /getAdminByCode with the page CSRF token: returned HTTP 419 Page Expired in the non-browser session; no retry bypass or TLS exception was attempted.
No request was made for owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax/account, personal, payment, or other unsafe fields. No login or CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass was attempted.
queryOutcomes.geometry: No parcel ID-plus-geometry response was returned. No GeoJSON sample was retained. The WUP point was not shifted and was not used as a parcel identifier.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier only when source-proven
uncertainty: The public national service and Saidpur coverage are evidenced, but survey/mouza selection did not yield a usable anonymous response in this attempt. Empty survey results and HTTP 419 are service-access outcomes, not evidence of parcel absence or citywide coverage failure.
